newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index up 1.0 pct in buoyant mood.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index up 1.0 pct in buoyant mood.

text.p: The Semdex index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius climbed by 3.70 points, 1.0 percent, to 357.70 on Wednesday with stocks buoyant overall.
Turnover surged to 19.01 million rupees on 677,625 shares from 6.11 million rupees on 237,710 shares on Monday.

Semdex gained ground for the 13th consecutive session, continuing an upward run which started in early December after the appointment of Vasant Bunwaree, a respected parliament member, as finance minister.

"You must not forget that stocks fell to very attractive levels during the second half of 1996 after the political turbulence," said one dealer, referring to a four-month absence of a finance minister before Bunwaree's appointment.

But the dealer added that the buoyant mood was soured by a fall in shares of Air Mauritius after the airline reported in late December an 86 percent slump in pre-tax profit to 26 million rupees for the half year ended 30 September, 1996.
Air Mauritius shed a rupee to 43.50 on 3,300 shares, bringing the decline to 13 percent in four trading sessions since financial results were released.
The fall of the airline stock was offset by rising shares of other leading companies, resulting in a net gain of the Semdex, bourse officials said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was up 2.0 rupees to 82 on 64,968 shares and State Bank of Mauritius gained 20 cents to another all-time high of 10.50 rupees on 81,040 shares.
Rogers rose 1.50 rupees to 92 on 4,462 shares and Ireland Blyth was 60 cents higher to 14.70 rupees on 4,125 shares.
